recipe.title: Scones
recipe.notes: I got this recipe from Helen Laver, a former colleague at Webb Henderson.
recipe.prep: Preheat oven to 220 deg C (200 deg C fan).

i.n: self-raising flour, plus more for dusting
jam and whipped cream to serve

method.s: Mix flour, salt, baking powder in a large bowl.
Add the butter, then rub in by hand until the mixture resembles fine crumbs.
Heat milk in the microwave for about 30 seconds - until warm, not hot. Add vanilla and lemon juice, then set aside for a moment.
Put a baking sheet in the oven.
Make a well in the dry mix, then add liquid and combine quickly with a cutlery knife - it will seem wet at first. Do not over-mix.
Scatter some flour on the work surface and tip the dough out. Dust the dough and hands with flour, then fold over two or three times until a bit smoother.
Pat dough out to just under 4 cm deep, then cut 5cm squares (for full-size scones).
Brush the tops of scones with beaten egg, then carefully place onto the hot baking tray.
Bake for about ten minutes until risen and golden on top. Eat just warm, or cold within a day of baking.
If freezing, freeze once cool. Defrost, then put in a low oven (160 deg C, or 140 deg C fan) for a few minutes to refresh.
